title: Closed etale support kernel and its exact left adjoint
statement: Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], with complementary open immersion $j:O\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. Work in the abelian categories of abelian sheaves on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Use direct images $i_*,j_*$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] and inverse images $i^{-1},j^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For each abelian sheaf $F$ on $X$, define $P_Z(F)=\ker(F\to j_*j^{-1}F)$ using the adjunction unit, and define $i^!_0F=i^{-1}P_Z(F)$. Then the canonical closed adjunction unit induces a natural isomorphism $P_Z(F)\xrightarrow{\sim}i_*i^!_0F$. The functor $i_*:\operatorname{Ab}(Z_{\mathrm{et}})\to\operatorname{Ab}(X_{\mathrm{et}})$ is exact and is left adjoint to $i^!_0$: for all abelian sheaves $G$ on $Z$ and $F$ on $X$, there is a natural bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_X(i_*G,F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_Z(G,i^!_0F)$.

source.place: Tag 09XQ, lemma-sections-with-support-acyclic, proof: the support adjunction, supported-sheaf identification and exactness of closed pushforward used there.

proof.text: The closed immersion $i$ is finite by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-finite]. Apply [lemma-weil-pbc-finite-direct-image-exact] to $i$ in the category of abelian etale sheaves. Thus $i_*$ is exact on all abelian sheaves, with no finiteness hypothesis on their sections and no quasi-compactness hypothesis on $j$.

source.place: Tag 09XQ, lemma-sections-with-support-acyclic, proof: exactness of i_*; section-closed-immersions.

proof.text: Write $u_F:F\to j_*j^{-1}F$ for the unit of [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and $a_F:P_Z(F)\to F$ for its kernel inclusion [def-pur-abelian-sheaf-kernel]. For $v:F\to F'$, naturality gives $u_{F'}v=j_*j^{-1}(v)u_F$, so $v a_F$ factors uniquely through $a_{F'}$; these factorizations define $P_Z$ on morphisms and obey the functor laws by uniqueness. Applying $i^{-1}$ defines the stated functor $i^!_0$. By [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-exact], $j^{-1}$ preserves this kernel. The counit $\varepsilon^j:j^{-1}j_*\to1$ is invertible by [lem-kun-open-immersion-restriction]; the triangle identity $\varepsilon^j_{j^{-1}F}\,j^{-1}(u_F)=1$ makes $j^{-1}(u_F)$ its inverse. Hence $j^{-1}P_Z(F)=\ker(j^{-1}u_F)=0$, naturally in $F$.

source.place: Tag 09XQ, preceding paragraph defining H_Z; Tag 04CA, proposition-closed-immersion-pushforward; open counit as restriction in section-extension-by-zero.

proof.text: For any abelian sheaf $H$ on $X$, [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-stalk-germ] identifies $(j^{-1}H)_{\bar o}$ with $H_{j\bar o}$. Every geometric point of $X$ outside $Z$ factors through the open subscheme $O$. Thus $j^{-1}H=0$ implies that every geometric stalk of $H$ outside $Z$ vanishes. Conversely, if all those stalks vanish, all stalks of $j^{-1}H$ vanish, and [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative] applied to $0\to j^{-1}H$ gives $j^{-1}H=0$. By [lem-kun-04ca], this vanishing criterion is precisely membership in the essential image of $i_*$. In particular Step 2 gives $P_Z(F)\cong i_*B$ for some abelian sheaf $B$ on $Z$, and applying the converse criterion to $i_*G$ gives $j^{-1}i_*G=0$ for every abelian sheaf $G$ on $Z$.

source.place: Tag 04CA, proposition-closed-immersion-pushforward (2), and Tag 09XQ, identification of H_Z with a sheaf on Z.

proof.text: Let $\eta^i:1\to i_*i^{-1}$ be the closed unit [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. The closed counit $\varepsilon^i:i^{-1}i_*\to1$ is invertible by [prop-openclosed-lowerstar-fully-faithful]. The triangle identity says $i_*(\varepsilon^i_B)\eta^i_{i_*B}=1$, so $\eta^i_{i_*B}=i_*(\varepsilon^i_B)^{-1}$ is invertible. For an isomorphism $e:P_Z(F)\to i_*B$ from Step 3, naturality gives $i_*i^{-1}(e)\eta^i_{P_Z(F)}=\eta^i_{i_*B}e$. All factors except $\eta^i_{P_Z(F)}$ are invertible, so it too is invertible. Consequently the particular canonical map $q_F=\eta^i_{P_Z(F)}:P_Z(F)\to i_*i^!_0F$ is an isomorphism; naturality of $\eta^i$ and the functor from Step 2 make $q$ a natural isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 04CA, proposition-closed-immersion-pushforward, proof: the canonical unit on supported sheaves; Tag 09XQ, preceding paragraph.

proof.text: For $h:i_*G\to F$, the open adjunction [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] identifies $\operatorname{Hom}_X(i_*G,j_*j^{-1}F)$ with $\operatorname{Hom}_O(j^{-1}i_*G,j^{-1}F)$. The latter has only the zero morphism by Step 3. Therefore $u_Fh=0$, and the kernel property [def-pur-abelian-sheaf-kernel] gives a unique $\widetilde h:i_*G\to P_Z(F)$ with $a_F\widetilde h=h$. Conversely every such $\widetilde h$ yields $h=a_F\widetilde h$. These operations are inverse and commute with precomposition in $G$ and postcomposition in $F$, since $a$ is natural and its factorizations are unique. This gives a natural bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_X(i_*G,F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_X(i_*G,P_Z(F))$.

source.place: Tag 09XQ, lemma-sections-with-support-acyclic, proof: every map from i_*G factors through the subsheaf of supported sections.

proof.text:
Compose the bijection of Step 5 with postcomposition by $q_F$ from Step 4, then with the inverse of the fully faithful map on Hom sets from [lem-kun-04ca]. This gives
$$\operatorname{Hom}_X(i_*G,F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_X(i_*G,i_*i^!_0F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_Z(G,i^!_0F).$$
Explicitly it sends $h$ to the unique $k$ satisfying $i_*k=q_F\widetilde h$; its inverse sends $k$ to $a_Fq_F^{-1}i_*k$. Substituting these formulas gives the identity in both orders, using faithfulness of $i_*$. Each operation is natural in $G,F$, as shown in Steps 4 and 5 and by functoriality of $i_*$. These are the claimed natural adjunction bijections for $i_*\dashv i^!_0$, with the exactness of its left adjoint already proved in Step 1.

source.place: Tag 09XQ, lemma-sections-with-support-acyclic, displayed Hom identity in its proof.

from.place: First two sentences of lem-pur-frame-independence.proof.md: justify the sheaf-theoretic supported edge through the closed support adjunction (returned item Step 4).

split_report.summary: Proved the support adjunction using the existing closed-support essential-image equivalence, actual closed and open adjunction counits, exact inverse image, and the existing finite-direct-image theorem. Made the canonical supported unit, kernel factorization and both directions of the natural Hom bijection explicit. No new nodes; statement unchanged.
split_report.blueprint: The first two sentences of the current lem-pur-frame-independence.proof.md need sheaf-theoretic supported cohomology. This supplies the closed-support adjunction used in Step 4 of its descendant lem-pur-relative-support-bottom-descent; the argument follows Stacks 09XQ and 04CA without changing the unit route.

tool_uses.why: The general equivalence between closed etale sheaves and sheaves supported on Z is a generic tool; the Kummer unit contains no such equivalence.
Only the underived open counit isomorphism is used to show the restricted support kernel is zero; no Kunneth or derived Leray assertion is invoked.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q36-4d1149a9a (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read in full: the item, all 14 cited statements (including the main-20261015 blueprint_update of finite-direct-image-exact and of geometric-stalk-conservative), and the Stacks source at Prop 04CA (proposition-closed-immersion-pushforward) and section-cohomology-support / Lemma 09XQ (lemma-sections-with-support-acyclic) with its Hom identity. The statement matches 09XQ+04CA: an arbitrary closed immersion and Ab(X_et), with no quasi-compact or torsion hypothesis. That generality is correct on the étale site because geometric points off Z factor through O and stalks are conservative. It is unlike the pro-étale def-pur-flasque-support and det-lem-formal-closed-support-adjunction, which need quasi-compact j and work with different coefficients. Step checks: (1) closed immersion is finite, then f_* is exact on Ab. (2) Kernel functoriality, j^{-1} exact, invertible open counit plus the triangle identity give j^{-1}P_Z=0. (3) Stalk-germ comparison, factoring through O and conservativity give the stalk criterion; lem-kun-04ca's essential-image clause gives P_Z F≅i_*B and j^{-1}i_*G=0. (4) Invertible closed counit (prop-openclosed-lowerstar-fully-faithful; its coefficient category includes Ab), triangle identity and naturality show the canonical unit is iso. (5) Open adjunction plus kernel universal property. (6) Composition with the 04CA full faithfulness; explicit inverses check out. Edge cases Z=X, Z=∅, nonreduced Z and injective F all work. No new nodes. The duplicate search over dag/nodes (09XQ, H_Z, ker(F→j_*j^{-1}F), support adjunctions) found no étale abelian duplicate. Acyclic; the only citer, lem-pur-relative-support-bottom-descent Step 4, uses exactly this. Route: the off-route, non-closed citations are lem-kun-04ca and the underived counit of lem-kun-open-immersion-restriction, both declared tool_uses, which I accept. The other citations are on route, closed, Mathlib leaves or definitions. No SGA. No fixes written. Minor: the item has no lean_audit field; this comes from the earlier NC creation and is maintainer metadata, not a fault of this split.

lean.statement: theorem supportedKernel_closedAdjunction {Z O X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : O ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j] (hcompl : IsCompl (Set.range i.base) (Set.range j.base)) : IsIso (Functor.whiskerLeft (supportedKernel j) (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).unit) ∧ PreservesFiniteLimits (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i) ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i) ∧ Nonempty (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i ⊣ supportedClosedInverseImage i j)
